points.description: States that selection sort finds the minimum (smallest) value among the remaining, unsorted elements. Equivalent wording such as 'the smallest of the elements not yet sorted' or 'the lowest value in the rest of the array' earns the mark. Saying it finds the maximum, or the minimum of the whole array only, does not earn it.

States that this minimum is swapped with the element at the current position, which is processed in order from left to right (the start of the unsorted part). Equivalent wording such as 'placed into the current index' or 'exchanged with the element being considered' earns the mark. The student does not need to use the words 'left to right' if the position being filled is clearly the current/next position in the array.
